findings.title: `include_website_name` is missing `?` and bypasses `untrusted_attributes` restrictions for TL0 users
findings.body: `ActiveModel::Serializer` requires conditional inclusion methods to end with a question mark (`include_website_name?`). Because `def include_website_name` has no `?`, it is never called and `website_name: nil` is always serialized even when a user has no `website`. In addition, `website` is declared in `untrusted_attributes` (lines 105-111) so that it is hidden when blank or when an anonymous visitor views a TL0 user (`scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)`). Because `website_name` is not in `untrusted_attributes`, a TL0 user's website is still serialized in `website_name` and rendered on the profile page to anonymous users. Adding `:website_name` to `untrusted_attributes` and removing `def include_website_name` (which would otherwise overwrite the `include_website_name?` method generated by `untrusted_attributes`) fixes both issues.

findings.title: `User#save` does not update `website_name` after saving profile preferences
findings.body: Previously, `websiteName` was a client-side computed property observing `model.website`, so editing `website` in user preferences immediately updated the displayed name. Now that the template renders the server-serialized `model.website_name`, `User#save` needs to copy `data.user.website_name` onto the model alongside `self.set('bio_excerpt', data.user.bio_excerpt)`. Without this, when a user adds or updates their website in preferences and views their profile without a full page reload, `model.website_name` remains `undefined` or stale while `model.website` points to the new URL.

findings.title: Subdomain websites of an apex Discourse instance do not include the URL path
findings.body: When the Discourse instance is hosted on an apex domain (e.g. `example.com`) and the user's website is on a subdomain (e.g. `http://www.example.com/user`), execution reaches the `else` branch where `discourse_host.ends_with?("." << website_host)` evaluates to `false`. As a result, `website_name` returns only `www.example.com` without `/user`, whereas the symmetric case (`forums.example.com` with `http://example.com/user`) includes the path.
